verdict.rationale: Published filing deadlines and penalty/interest schedules are a fair question for a national company registry, so the axis applies. However, both mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in returned HTTP 403 at robots.txt, and no page content was fetched. There is therefore no evidence that exact deadline or penalty figures are published, and the 403s show only that the content could not be checked, not that it is absent.
